title: Lenacapavir Table 2 SAR extraction with censored-clearance analysis
summary: Transcribe the sourced Lenacapavir R1 SAR table, derive potency/rank fields, and provide a reusable analysis script validated on a hidden table.
taskPrompt: Read input/TASK_PROMPT.md and the staged manuscript PDF. Extract Table 2 and produce submission.csv, analysis.json, and a reusable analyze_table.py under output/ with the exact schemas, units, censored-value conventions, and formulas specified.
agentMustDo: Inspect page 8 of input/source_paper.pdf and transcribe compounds 23 and 25–40.
Write output/submission.csv with the exact seven-column schema and all 17 rows.
Compute pEC50, average-tie potency ranks, and HLM_class without changing source strings.
Write output/analysis.json with the specified counts, median, best compound, and Spearman invariant.
Write output/analyze_table.py that generalizes the analysis to an unseen evaluator table.

evaluation: Hard gates reject missing, oversized, malformed, wrong-header, duplicate-ID, or incomplete outputs. The score is 0.10 schema, 0.35 exact source-row transcription, 0.20 derived columns, 0.25 visible analysis invariant, and 0.10 hidden-table generalization. Numeric source strings, censored values, units, row set, formulas, and tie handling are checked deterministically.
